serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Axiom Convergence Engine (ACE) is an AI/ML governance, control, and audit cloud service offering designed to evaluate source validity, structural readiness, claim scope, authorization boundaries, evidence integrity, and reviewability before AI-assisted output is permitted to move downstream. ACE produces machine-verifiable governance decisions and reviewable evidence records for high-stakes AI/ML workflows. This listing represents an Initial Implementation offering pursuing FedRAMP 20x certification; ACE is not currently FedRAMP Certified or authorized to operate in a federal production environment.
